blocks.html: Unconcealed vertical openings totally within an individual residential dwelling unit and connecting four stories or less, where such dwelling unit is fully sprinklered in accordance with Sections 903.3.1.1, 903.3.1.2 or 903.3.1.3, shall be permitted.
